ithos.title.t: A light for sweeter dreams and peaceful nights.

ithos.alt.t: ithos®️ pine wood lamps, where animals, mystical figures and means of transport come to life through a soft light that illuminates dreams and warms hearts.

cathelier.title.t: Unique keepsakes, small details, unforgettable moments

cathelier.alt.t: At cathelier, every keepsake comes to life in the small wooden details, with love and care to celebrate special moments and transform beautiful moments into memories forever

cathelier.quantidade.texto1.t:
At cathelier, we create personalised pieces in acrylic, wood, MDF and plywood, designed to make every occasion even more special.
Wedding, christening, communion and birthday keepsakes, corporate gifts, trophies and birth keepsakes. Each piece is created with delicacy, care and attention to detail.

cathelier.quantidade.texto2.t: Get in touch and share your idea and the quantity you need. We will be delighted to provide you with a quote and an estimated delivery date.

cathelier.mais.titulo.t: There is so much more to discover

cathelier.mais.texto.t: From birth to the most special moments, we create personalised pieces for decoration, keepsakes, gifts and trophies in wood, MDF, plywood and acrylic to celebrate stories, creating unique memories and keepsakes.
